instruction: Disconnect USB and wait for the power LED to go out. Connect only the large-board E30–A55 OUT-load jumper. Keep A55–C35 absent, B28–B35 1 kohm, A23–A45, I50–A4, D50–G50, B50–B23, the renewed GND return and the specimen unchanged. Remove probes and reconnect the same USB port.

fixed_response.verbatim: USB was off; I connected only the known 9.99 kohm OUT-to-REF load, retained the specimen and remaining wiring, removed probes, and reconnected the same USB port.
